codeReview.summary: The feature delivered the richer pagination controls and URL sync, but the initial implementation hid the pagination bar whenever the current page had zero rows and also computed an impossible visible range for out-of-range empty pages. Both issues violated the feature behavior because operators could not recover from empty/out-of-range pages and the summary text became inaccurate.

issues.description: The pagination bar was gated by `attempts.length > 0`, so navigating to an out-of-range page (or a page emptied by filters) removed the page number, page-size selector, and Prev/Next controls entirely. That breaks the requirement that pagination remain usable via URL-synced state and prevents recovery from invalid pages.

The added pagination tests exercised a duplicated local `PaginationBar` helper instead of the production component logic, and they even documented the impossible summary text `Showing 101-70 of 70 results` as expected behavior. This weakened coverage and missed the out-of-range empty-page bug shipped in the feature.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker found that the authenticated Email Delivery route could render only the shell/header state, which blocked live inspection of the pagination controls, but the shared library already documents that this environment may require authenticated validation and can still have limited data visibility. The mission guidance could be clearer that empty/out-of-range pagination behavior must be validated with component tests even when the browser surface lacks rows.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff for commit 91d26026 reports agent-browser could only see header/filter content; `.factory/library/user-testing.md` notes the authenticated primary surface and env-dependent dev harness limitations.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker deviated from the fullstack-worker TDD requirement and added tests after implementation; the resulting test file duplicated pagination markup instead of exercising the real client path. The skill states tests must fail first, but it may help to explicitly warn against asserting behavior in helper replicas when the production UI is embedded in a larger client component.

summary: Review failed: commit `91d26026` added the richer pagination UI, but it hid the controls on empty/out-of-range pages and the tests validated a duplicated helper with incorrect range math instead of the real client behavior.
